sources.title: [2502.03459] SKI Models: Skeleton Induced Vision-Language Embeddings ...
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce SKI models, which integrate 3D skeletons into the vision-language embedding space. SKI models leverage a skeleton-language model, SkeletonCLIP, to infuse skeleton information into Vision Language Models (VLMs) and Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) through collaborative training.
